Foundation.description: Low-level query primitives for direct sidecar access, chaining, and diffing.

tools.query_raw: Query one approved sidecar endpoint with parameter passthrough and pagination.
tools.chain_query: Run sequential approved queries whose steps may reference prior results.
tools.compare_snapshots: Diff two queries to the same approved endpoint.

Intelligence.description: Cross-domain analysis, trend detection, and anomaly scanning.

tools.correlate: Find shared entities across two or more intelligence domains.
tools.trend: Analyze a time series from sentinel history.
tools.anomaly_scan: Compare current domain values with historical baselines.

Watchlists & Alerts.description: Persistent tracking lists and threshold-based alert rules.

tools.watchlist_manage: Create, list, update, or delete persistent watchlists.
tools.watchlist_check: Evaluate watchlists and record newly observed activity.
tools.alert_rules_manage: Create, list, update, or delete threshold alert rules.
tools.alert_check: Evaluate active alert rules against current data.

Aggregate.description: Broad situational awareness tools that pull from multiple sources at once.

tools.get_sitrep: Summarize conflicts, markets, weather, infrastructure, and service health.
tools.get_threat_landscape: Summarize active conflict, cyber, and crisis threats.
tools.get_market_overview: Summarize indices, crypto, flows, sentiment, and macro signals.
tools.get_cyber_intel: Summarize IOCs, KEVs, phishing, malware URLs, and threat pulses.
tools.get_weather_environment: Summarize weather alerts and environmental conditions.
tools.get_infrastructure_status: Summarize power, water, radiation, and critical infrastructure.
tools.get_military_posture: Summarize military aircraft, vessels, posture, and analysis.
tools.check_feed_health: Probe the sidecar and representative data feeds.
tools.sitrep_bundle: Return a pre-filtered multi-domain intelligence bundle.

Granular.description: Targeted lookups and searches for specific entities or data points.

tools.search_conflicts: Search armed-conflict events by region, country, dates, or type.
tools.search_news: Search current headlines from configured news providers.
tools.lookup_ip: Combine IP reputation, classification, and geolocation.
tools.lookup_cve: Search vulnerability intelligence by CVE or text.
tools.lookup_vessel: Look up a vessel by MMSI or name.
tools.lookup_flight: Look up military aircraft by ICAO hex or callsign.
tools.get_region_brief: Combine security, conflict, weather, and alert context for a place.

Analyst.description: Renderer-side hypotheses, forecasts, feedback, and reasoning diagnostics.

tools.get_mode_forecast: Read the current cross-domain posture forecast.
tools.get_hot_entities: Read entities with elevated cross-domain activity.
tools.dismiss_hypothesis: Dismiss a hypothesis in renderer state.
tools.get_reasoning_metrics: Read reasoning latency and counter metrics.

Intel Expansion.description: Specialized cyber, infrastructure, supply, aviation, finance, disaster, and radiation sources.

tools.get_cyber_threats: Fetch C2, IOC, and malware URL feeds.
tools.get_space_weather_extra: Fetch extended aurora and solar-flare indicators.
tools.get_grid_outages: Fetch grid outages for an exact county FIPS.
tools.lookup_entity: Look up a legal entity identifier.

Diagnostics.description: Live runtime triage, pipeline evidence, and algorithm health.

tools.get_capabilities: Report domain readiness, credential coverage, and unavailable capability reasons.
tools.get_monitor_status: Read the latest persistent drift and quarantine monitor result.
tools.run_monitor_cycle: Run and persist a drift and quarantine monitor cycle.
tools.diagnose_runtime: Ranked live runtime findings with optional deep route probes.
tools.get_algorithm_diagnostics: Read bounded algorithm evaluation and tuning health.
tools.get_weekly_evaluation_report: Read the latest or a selected completed weekly algorithm evaluation report.
tools.generate_weekly_evaluation_report: Finalize accumulated completed weeks into immutable local evaluation reports.

tools.help: Read the tool index, man pages, conceptual guides, and examples.
